title: TABLECONTENT block-cell attributes beyond two
mode: Bounded serializer/adapter extension with runtime-generated ASCII/Binary controls

scope.sourceProfile: One AC1027 TABLECONTENT object with one block-backed cell and three ordered ATTDEF attributes, each uniquely owned by the referenced BLOCK_RECORD.
scope.fieldProof: Physical group 91 count is 3; each ordered group 330 ATTDEF identity, group 301 text, and group 92 one-based index is checked against a fresh typed readback. The block reference is checked against the emitted BLOCK_RECORD identity.
scope.handleRemapping: ATTDEF and BLOCK_RECORD source identities are resolved through the writer's actual source-to-emitted identity maps; wire values are compared with fresh typed readback rather than an unsupported forced block-entity remap.
scope.claimBoundary: One block content in one TABLECONTENT cell, bounded attribute transport and this library's typed readback only. No native table rendering, source DWG semantic proof, or support claim.

implementation.summary: Raised the TABLECONTENT block-cell attribute bound from two to the existing 10,000-item model/parser limit in both the low-level writer and adapter closure check. Duplicate ATTDEF identities are rejected with indexed sets; the adapter builds a requested-handle index and scans block ATTDEF definitions once per cell rather than rescanning all blocks for every attribute. Aggregate string/output bounds and ownership/remap checks remain in force.
implementation.failureAndRetry: With three attributes present, missing ATTDEF, wrong-owner ATTDEF and duplicate target controls each refuse atomically and preserve the destination sentinel. Repairing the same source adapter allows successful ASCII and Binary exports and readback.

limitations: The runtime profile proves three attributes, not stress behavior at the 10,000-item bound.
Multiple block contents/cells and TABLE block geometry remain unqualified.
Serializer readback does not prove native CAD rendering or independent source semantics.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: Single-cell TABLECONTENT block-backed attribute transport above the former two-attribute ceiling, with bounded identity closure and failure/retry proof.
planImpact.remainingP5Scope: FIELDLIST/child and additional source/version profiles; standalone 1x1 multiple FIELD references; multiple block contents/cells and block geometry; remaining CONTENTFORMAT/CELLSTYLEMAP and AC1018 TABLE profiles; independent native rendering evidence.
